params.name: orchestration_rule_id
params.description: Optionally filter by the initiating orchestration rule ids. There is a limit of 100 orchestration rule ids that can be specified in a single request.

params.name: source_asset
params.description: Optionally filter by source assets. There is a limit of 100 source assets that can be specified in a single request.

params.name: destination_asset
params.description: Optionally filter by destination assets. There is a limit of 100 destination assets ids that can be specified in a single request.

params.name: status
params.description: Optionally filter by statuses. There is a limit of 100 statuses that can be specified in a single request.

params.name: created_at.lt
params.description: Include timestamps strictly less than lt. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: created_at.lte
params.description: Include timestamps less than or equal to lte. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: created_at.eq
params.description: Include timestamps exactly equal to eq. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: created_at.gte
params.description: Include timestamps greater than or equal to gte. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: created_at.gt
params.description: Include timestamps strictly greater than gt. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 100 if no limit is provided. Maximum 1000.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for the results. Defaults to DESC by created_at time.

params.name: page_cursor
params.description: Optional Cursor for getting the next page of results.

params.name: orchestration_id
params.description: Optionally filter by a list of orchestration IDs. There is a limit of 100 orchestration ids that can be specified in a single request.

params.name: profile_id
params.description: Optionally filter by the target profiles. There is a limit of 100 profiles that can be specified in a single request.

params.name: ref_id
params.description: Optionally filter by client-provided reference IDs. There is a limit of 100 ref_ids that can be specified in a single request.

items.docs:
List all orchestrations, optionally filtering and paging the results.

By default, orchestrations are returned in reverse chronological (descending)
order by creation time. If no query parameters are supplied,
the response will include up to the last 100 orchestrations which
were created.

The paginated results default to display up to 100 orchestrations, unless
otherwise specified with the `limit` parameter. The maximum `limit` value is 1000.

Creates a one-time orchestration that moves assets from a source profile to a destination.
Use this endpoint when funds already reside on the Paxos platform and need to be transferred or converted as part of a single workflow.

A request to create an orchestration can fail with one of the following
types of errors:
 - [Insufficient Funds](https://developer.paxos.com/docs/v2/problems/insufficient-funds)
   if the Profile (`profile_id`) has insufficient available balance to
   fund the execution.
Retreives a specific orchestration using its orchestration ID.
